snippet.title: Hyperspaced | Launch Trailer | Out Now on PC, Xbox & Switch!
snippet.description:
Hyperspaced Is Warping Into Your Living Room! 🛸

Blast your enemies, extinguish fires, clean up, repair, recycle and explore where no one has screwed up before! Team up and face swarms of foes as you pilot your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Save the Multiverse in Hyperspaced, a chaotic co-op space action game for 1-4 players!

Steam: https://bit.ly/45eaMue
Epic: https://bit.ly/46DHE0X
Switch: https://bit.ly/45d8ZFU
Xbox: https://bit.ly/3GT5Cui
